info.name: Lab 2 - API Gateway
info.description: Everything goes through the gateway (port 8080). Run the folders in order. The token from '1. Auth' is used for every request through collection-level Bearer auth; admin requests use adminToken. Folders 8-9 (Gabriel): Player and Crafting through the gateway, the 429 burst and the services' own 408. Folders 6 and 9 need DEMO_MODE=true and low limits.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("playerId")) { pm.collectionVariables.set("playerId", "aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"); } // seeded alice in Player Service

request.description: adminKey must match ADMIN_KEY in deploy/.env
Open the returned wsUrl in a Postman WebSocket tab (or wscat -c). The connection goes straight to Game, not through the gateway.

exec: pm.test("direct URL to Game with token", () => { const u = pm.response.json().wsUrl; pm.expect(u).to.match(/^ws:\/\//); pm.expect(u).to.include("token="); });

item.name: 6. Limits (needs DEMO_MODE=true)
item.description: Set DEMO_MODE=true in deploy/.env. 429: run this folder with the Collection Runner (or the curl loop in the README) with MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS set low.

request.description: Game's own timeout (SERVICE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, 5000) fires before the gateway's (10000).

item.name: 7. Across services (World + Zombie seeded)
item.description: A full game through the gateway: Player login, World rooms, Zombie types, Game -> Exam, Game -> Player. Needs the World and Zombie seed scripts (README section 10).

item.name: Me with the Player token (gateway -> X-User-Id)

exec: pm.test("professor and tourist exist", () => { pm.expect(t.find(z => z.code === "PROFESSOR")).to.be.ok; pm.expect(t.find(z => z.code === "TOURIST")).to.be.ok; });

item.name: 8. Player + Crafting through the gateway
item.description: Player login tokens are validated by the gateway, which forwards only X-User-Id / X-User-Role. Crafting calls Resource and Player through the gateway's internal listener.

item.name: Setup: give bob a sandwich (service-style grant)
Alice proposes a trade (coffee for bob's sandwich)

exec: // give alice a coffee first so the collection can be run many times
body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({ itemCode: "COFFEE", quantity: 1 }) } }, () => {});

item.name: Recipes unlocked for alice (Crafting -> Player, Exam, World, Resource)
Setup: give alice wood (Resource, testing endpoint)
Alice crafts a Barricade Kit (Crafting -> Resource consume, Crafting -> Player item)

request.description: No playerId: Crafting takes it from X-User-Id.

exec: pm.test("completed for alice", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("completed"); pm.expect(b.playerId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("alice")); });

item.name: The item is in alice's inventory
9. Limits: 429 and the service timeout (needs DEMO_MODE=true)
item.description: Set low limits for the demo in deploy/.env: GATEWAY_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS=3, DEMO_MODE=true. 'burst' (default 10) must be larger than GATEWAY_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS.
